slug: 2017-01-01 AU - Report on the Status of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in Africa
note: Continental civil registration status report from the October 2016 monitoring round; a footnote lists Sudan among the fifteen countries that did not fill in the monitoring form, and every other 'Sudan' in the passages is South Sudan. The one mention of health information systems is a regional generality about missing linkage with civil registration records. States nothing about a health information system in Sudan.
